events.description: A large, sudden explosion occurs in the background behind a parked armored vehicle, producing a massive fireball followed by a dense plume of black and grey smoke that rapidly expands and obscures the scene.

A large, violent explosion occurs in the background, producing a bright fireball followed by a rapidly expanding plume of black and grey smoke and debris; the armored vehicle in the foreground remains stationary.

A large, sudden explosion occurs to the left of the armored vehicle, producing a rapidly expanding plume of thick black smoke and a visible dust/blast wave moving outward. The smoke column rises vertically and begins to billow immediately.

Secondary or continuing detonation effects: the smoke plume continues rapid expansion and turbulent mixing; debris is visibly ejected horizontally near ground level in frame f2, indicating ongoing blast dynamics.

Sustained post-detonation phase: dense black smoke continues rising and spreading, with visible ground disturbance (dust/debris cloud) persisting near the blast origin. No new ignition or secondary blast observed, but the event remains active as a single explosive incident.

A large, rapidly expanding plume of dark smoke and dust rises from the left side of the frame, indicating a recent explosion. The smoke column grows significantly in volume and height between f0 and f5, with visible turbulent motion and ground disturbance consistent with a blast event.

A large, rapidly expanding plume of dark smoke and dust rises from the left side of the frame, consistent with a recent ground-level explosion. The smoke column grows significantly in volume and height between f0 and f3, indicating a sudden energetic release.

Two armed personnel are visible near the armored vehicle (f4–f11); one exits the rear hatch and moves to the right while another stands nearby. Their postures and proximity to the vehicle amid ongoing smoke suggest active engagement or response to hostile activity, though no direct combat is captured in these frames.

A large, rapidly expanding plume of dark smoke and dust rises from the left side of the frame, consistent with a recent ground-level explosion. The plume grows significantly between f0 and f3, indicating a sudden energetic release.

After the initial explosion, multiple armed personnel are seen dismounting and taking positions around the armored vehicle (visible from f4 onward). Their postures—crouching, scanning, moving tactically near the vehicle while smoke still billows—indicate active engagement or response to hostile action in the vicinity.
